component.name: TKS Desktop
TKS 桌面版
component.summary: Taki Shiina AI companion client for Linux
椎名立希 AI 陪伴应用的 Linux 桌面客户端

description.p: TKS Desktop is the Linux desktop peer of the TKS Android client. It shares the same backend and account, and keeps a persistent WebSocket connection so replies arrive even while the window is hidden in the system tray.

Features: streaming replies with multi-bubble splitting, clipboard image paste and vision understanding, scheduled reminders, five notification categories with a do-not-disturb window, global shortcut, autostart, full-text local search, points and level progression with makeup cards, and interaction gifts.
TKS Desktop 是 TKS Android 客户端的桌面对等物，与手机端共享同一后端与账号， 常驻托盘保持 WebSocket 长连接，窗口隐藏时也能即时收到消息。
主要能力：流式回复与多气泡拆分、剪贴板贴图与识图、定时提醒、 五类桌面通知与勿扰时段、全局快捷键、开机自启、本地全文搜索、 积分等级与补签卡、互动礼物。
首个版本：对齐 Android 端全部 P0/P1 能力，并叠加桌面试用增强能力。

ul.li: 流式对话、多气泡拆分、图片识图、剪贴板贴图
托盘常驻、全局快捷键、开机自启、五类桌面通知
定时提醒（本地持久化，重启后重载）
